declarations.reason: The run's Aisle 9 clutter, mod displays, shelf grabs and barricades are regenerated every run from the zone catalog, the shelf stock and the run seed, and they move or vanish with the shutters, so they stay runtime-owned. The static store is authored: editor.scene.json places the shelving runs either side of the walkway, the end-caps at the shelf ends, the section crowns and seams, the frozen cases and pallet clusters, the floor decals and the ambient freezer fog, scrubber suds and pigeons (scripts/author-corridor.ts, author-yard.ts, author-ambience.ts), all outside the drivable aisle. The five route-course departments are runtime-owned whole: their shelving edges, ceiling lights, scatter, landmarks and hazard set-pieces are placed from each department's course and dressing tables in src/game/world/setup.ts, so moving a piece of a course moves its scenery with it.
